claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is currently on a 10-day crewed journey to fly around the Moon and return to Earth.
Artemis II marks the first human lunar mission since 1972.
The Artemis II crew launched from Kennedy Space Center on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II crew has four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission's return is expected to land in the Pacific Ocean.
The Artemis II crew is traveling to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew is flying roughly 5,000 kilometers (3,000 miles) from the Moon's surface before returning to Earth.
The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission duration is 10 days.
The Artemis II mission tests the Orion capsule's life support systems in deep space.
The Artemis II mission tests the Orion capsule's navigation systems in deep space.
